description_en: Updates the global configuration of a Global Traffic Manager (GTM) instance
description_zh: 根据传入参数修改GTM实例配置
name: UpdateGtmInstanceGlobalConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GTM instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the instance.

This parameter is required when you update the instance for the first time. It is optional for subsequent updates
parameters.help_zh:
实例名称。

首次更新必填，再次更新则非必填
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The primary domain name.

This parameter is required when you update the instance for the first time. It is optional for subsequent updates
parameters.help_zh:
主域名。
首次更新必填，再次更新非必填
parameters.name: user_domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The load balancing policy. Valid values:

ALL_RR: round-robin

RATIO: weighted round-robin

This parameter is required when you update the instance for the first time. It is optional for subsequent updates
parameters.help_zh:
均衡策略。取值：

ALL_RR: 负载均摊
RATIO：加权轮询
首次更新必填，再次更新非必填
parameters.name: lba_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The alert contact group. Only one alert contact group is supported.

This parameter is required when you update the instance for the first time. It is optional for subsequent updates
parameters.help_zh:
报警组。目前仅支持一个报警组。

首次更新必填，再次更新非必填
parameters.name: alert_group

parameters.help_en:
The connection type. Valid values:

SYSTEM_ASSIGN: system-assigned

CUSTOM: custom
parameters.help_zh:
接入方式。取值：
SYSTEM_ASSIGN：系统分配
CUSTOM：自定义
parameters.name: cname_mode

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required when you set CnameMode to CUSTOM. The value must be the primary domain name
parameters.help_zh: CnameMode为CUSTOM接入时必传，必须是主域名
parameters.name: cname_custom_domain_name

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
